messages:
alice: Starting regional shadow probe to eu-west1 green pool at 09:00 UTC. Shadow 5% traffic, no cutover. tagging release v3.2.1.
deploy-bot: Deploy started: artifact redwood-service:v3.2.1 -> green pool eu-west1. trace_id=tx-9a4f
alice: Plan: 5% shadow for 15m, check error-rate and p95, then decide whether to ramp to 20% weighted shift. Will pin session cookie for new clients.
bob: Quick q — do we need to pre-drain any long-lived lanes before a weighted shift?
carol: For shadow no. For a weighted shift we'll coordinate a gradual drain (0->20%) and keep old sessions until they expire.
dmitri: Telemetry thresholds: error_rate delta > 0.75pp OR p95 > 350ms => manual rollback recommended. Log any anomalies.
oncall: Ack. I'll watch infra dashboards and be ready to page.
deploy-bot: Routing update applied: set shadow_weight=5 for green in eu-west1. cmd=/usr/local/bin/routerctl set-shadow --region eu-west1 --pool green --weight 5
alice: Copying ramp command for later in thread: 
``
/usr/local/bin/routerctl shift --region eu-west1 --from blue --to green --weight 20 --pin cookie=green-v3 --reason "canary 20%"
```
bob: Pinning cookie only for new sessions ok? Concern: long-lived GRPC streams.
carol: Yes — cookie pin affects new HTTP sessions. GRPC streams are sticky at connection level; we won't forcibly drop them.
dmitri: Also prepare the quick rollback command and perms note. We need an operator who can push routerctl with --force.
oncall: I've verified oncall has perms and escalation path.
deploy-bot: Metric probe (t+8m): error_rate 0.4% (baseline 0.3%), p95 290ms. No alerts.
alice: Nice. Continue hold. If everything looks stable at 15m we ramp to 20% using the command above.
(15 minutes later)
deploy-bot: Metric probe (t+15m): error_rate 1.4% (baseline 0.3%), p95 420ms. region=eu-west1, rolling window=1m
dmitri: That's above threshold (p95>350ms and error spike). Recommend immediate rollback to blue.
alice: Agreed. Executing rollback to abort canary.
alice: Rollback command (executing now):
``
/usr/local/bin/routerctl shift --region eu-west1 --to blue --weight 100 --reason "auto-rollback due to error spike"
```
deploy-bot: Rollback executed. Traffic now 100% -> blue. router_op_id=op-77c2.
deploy-bot: Incident ticket created: INC-2026-112 (auto-created on rollback).
oncall: I'm opening a postmortem stub and collecting logs for the time window. Paging if it continues.
carol: Noting in release notes draft: "Canary aborted for v3.2.1 due to increased error rate and latency in eu-west1. Reverted to blue. Investigating DB connection pool regression suspected in green build."
bob: Suggest we pin blue for clients that rely on session affinity until fix deployed? Thoughts?
alice: Let's avoid a permanent pin. We'll keep blue as active for now and mark green as quarantined. If customers ask, we'll route them to blue via maintenance notice.
dmitri: Prep a hotfix branch with the suspected fix. Aim for hotfix deploy to green tomorrow 02:00 UTC. Change-window request submitted to infra (ticket CHG-894).
oncall: I'll coordinate the watch window and SRE handover.
alice: Thanks team. Follow-ups: update release notes, link postmortem stub, schedule hotfix and small canary next night. Closing this thread.
